concepts/ab-harness-tracecompare.title: A/B harness (_TRACE/_COMPARE)
concepts/ab-harness-tracecompare.description: Built-in env-var pairs (e.g., _TRACE=1, _COMPARE=1 + _COMPARE_LIMIT) that make a decision revisitable from one build via two env-var runs, without patching or a second libggml-sycl.so.

concepts/accepted-is-not-the-same-as-cor.title: Accepted is not the same as correct
concepts/accepted-is-not-the-same-as-cor.description: A primitive being accepted by oneDNN (no refusal in the log) does not guarantee correct numerics — the 3-D WOQ scale mask is accepted yet reproducibly wrong on B70; the same trap as ext_oneapi_enable_peer_access.

concepts/accuracy-ratio.title: Accuracy ratio
concepts/accuracy-ratio.description: Scoring kernel accuracy as the fit ratio between candidate oracles (dfloat must fit ≥100× better than q8_1-MMVQ) rather than as an absolute tolerance against one oracle.

concepts/across-process-spread.title: Across-process spread
concepts/across-process-spread.description: Basing figures on mean ± sd across ≥5 separate processes with min–max range, never llama-bench's tighter within-process ±.

concepts/allocationcontrolclass.title: allocation_control_class
concepts/allocationcontrolclass.description: The stamp on each owner (CACHE_BACKING, CACHE_SUBALLOCATION, EXTERNAL_EXACT) that is the enforceable part of the contract, specified in the canonical doc §3.1.

concepts/baseline-measurement-discipline.title: Baseline measurement discipline
concepts/baseline-measurement-discipline.description: Mean ± sd across ≥5 separate processes, free VRAM recorded each run, GT-reset checks before/after, and selector-based device keying.

concepts/bench-guard-preflight-refusal.title: Bench-guard preflight refusal
concepts/bench-guard-preflight-refusal.description: The three ordered host-health preflight checks (stale GPU tenant, Shmem ceiling, PL2 throttle/active card) that can refuse a benchmark run with exit 3.

concepts/bench-guard-validsuspect-verdic.title: bench-guard VALID/SUSPECT verdict
concepts/bench-guard-validsuspect-verdic.description: First-line stamp on every archived benchmark log; a number whose log does not start with '# bench-guard: VALID' is not a citable baseline.

concepts/buffer-scoped-weight-provenance.title: Buffer-scoped weight provenance
concepts/buffer-scoped-weight-provenance.description: A second legitimate owner-minting occasion at buffer allocation, seeded from managed_meta.id and namespaced by the top bit (1ull << 63), so buffer and model Registry id spaces are disjoint by enforcement.

concepts/capability-query-vs-capability-.title: Capability query vs capability check
concepts/capability-query-vs-capability-.description: can_access_peer is the honest device-level capability query, whereas enable_peer_access is a no-op on no-P2P hardware and not a valid capability check.

concepts/correctness-gates-before-throug.title: Correctness gates before throughput
concepts/correctness-gates-before-throug.description: Mistral/GPT-OSS completion gates that must pass before any llama-bench number is trusted, on both arms of any A/B.

concepts/cross-device-in-order-dependenc.title: Cross-device in-order dependency fixes
concepts/cross-device-in-order-dependenc.description: Local compute-runtime fixes for ordering dependencies across devices, carried in the patched 26.22 build.

concepts/devicelost-on-multi-gpu-context.title: DEVICE_LOST on multi-GPU context
concepts/devicelost-on-multi-gpu-context.description: Behavior where the single-context multi-GPU Level Zero configuration on compute-runtime 26.x triggers DEVICE_LOST, motivating per-device isolated contexts in the test.

concepts/diverted-library-path-symlink-r.title: Diverted library path / symlink rollback
concepts/diverted-library-path-symlink-r.description: Installing the patched driver via a diverted libze_intel_gpu.so.1 symlink with stock/prior versions preserved, enabling rollback without removing the diversion.

concepts/dmmv-coalesced-fallback.title: DMMV coalesced fallback
concepts/dmmv-coalesced-fallback.description: Coalesced dot-product kernel that is a fallback/debug path, not the production batch=1 TG kernel for reorder-eligible types.

concepts/epoch-refcounted-transient-zone.title: Epoch-refcounted transient zones
concepts/epoch-refcounted-transient-zone.description: A ring of equal-sized regions each carrying a live-handle counter (the epoch) that rewinds on zero, giving reset-only scratch/staging zones a real per-allocation release path without replacing the bump allocator or the reset.

concepts/fail-closed-admission-contract.title: Fail-closed admission contract
concepts/fail-closed-admission-contract.description: Once an XMX_TILED-claimed op reaches the batched MoE PP executor, every internal decline throws ggml_sycl_fallback_error rather than returning false, because the outer dispatch has already skipped every other route that could decode the claimed layout.

concepts/fail-closed-contract.title: Fail-closed contract
concepts/fail-closed-contract.description: Once an op is claimed to a layout its fallback cannot decode, internal executor decline points must throw ggml_sycl_fallback_error instead of returning false.

concepts/flag-presence-test.title: Flag presence-test
concepts/flag-presence-test.description: Reading an env var as getenv != nullptr, so =0 enables the behavior and only unset disables it (GGML_SYCL_UNIFIED_FORCE_LEGACY), with static latching per process.

concepts/free-vram-confound.title: Free-VRAM confound
concepts/free-vram-confound.description: A B70 run reporting ~13.8 GB instead of ~32.6 GB is confounded (e.g., by ComfyUI) and discarded; holders verified via a drm-pdev fdinfo sweep.

concepts/host-bounce.title: Host bounce
concepts/host-bounce.description: Transferring data device→host→device as a fallback when direct P2P is unavailable; validated via ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:0,1.

concepts/interleaved-ab-design.title: Interleaved A/B design
concepts/interleaved-ab-design.description: Alternating treatment and control arms so session drift loads both equally; blocked designs can invert the sign of a measured effect (−3.6% vs +2.3%).

concepts/invalidated-vs-superseded.title: Invalidated vs superseded
concepts/invalidated-vs-superseded.description: Baseline rows measured under a hidden tenant or wrong default arm are invalidated (not gateable) rather than superseded by a newer number.

concepts/kernel-confirmation-from-output.title: Kernel confirmation from output, not setup
concepts/kernel-confirmation-from-output.description: Because the fast-path can bypass setup preconditions, the actually-running kernel must be verified from GGML_SYCL_MUL_MAT_ROUTE_TRACE=1 or an oracle-fit ratio — a passing precondition is not evidence about which kernel ran.

concepts/known-stale-baseline.title: Known-stale baseline
concepts/known-stale-baseline.description: A correctly measured number that must no longer gate anything because the measurement conditions (hidden tenant) invalidated it.

concepts/layout-follows-residency.title: Layout follows residency
concepts/layout-follows-residency.description: Wherever a weight lives, it is materialized in the optimal layout for the processor that executes on it (per device), and dispatch routes must consume the materialized layout, never the reverse.

concepts/lazy-re-resolution.title: Lazy re-resolution
concepts/lazy-re-resolution.description: A global generation counter bumped whenever a pointer could have moved makes resolve() a ~3 ns compare-and-return fast path, with resolve_slow() re-querying the cache on a miss so weights can migrate VRAM↔host transparently.

concepts/leases-inusecount.title: Leases (in_use_count)
concepts/leases-inusecount.description: A live WEIGHT handle increments the cache entry's in_use_count; eviction may only remove entries with in_use_count == 0, so a held lease means a missing release to fix, never a forced eviction.

concepts/live-card-derivation.title: Live card derivation
concepts/live-card-derivation.description: Resolving the DRM card from the PCI device symlink (0000:03:00.0 B70 / 0000:07:00.0 B50) instead of a static cardN index that moves across boots.

concepts/masking-bug.title: Masking bug
concepts/masking-bug.description: A hidden co-resident tenant that makes a defect or a slow arm invisible, e.g., the hung llama-cli tenants in llama.cpp-o3h1 or the OpenVINO embedder behind rows A–D.

concepts/measurement-masking-co-resident.title: Measurement masking (co-resident tenants)
concepts/measurement-masking-co-resident.description: A secretly co-resident process (codescout's embedder on B50) inflates baseline measurements, producing invalid baselines that must be filed separately (llama.cpp-9klr) and that make stale baseline rows unusable for gating.

concepts/misleading-error-attribution.title: Misleading error attribution
concepts/misleading-error-attribution.description: A P2P refusal surfacing as UR/ZE_RESULT_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY (error 39), which can misdirect debugging toward a nonexistent VRAM-budget bug.

concepts/mmvq-with-q81-activations.title: MMVQ with q8_1 activations
concepts/mmvq-with-q81-activations.description: Production quantized kernel that quantizes activations to 8-bit per 32-element blocks (scale amax/127, per-block fp16 sum), matching the upstream CUDA convention.

concepts/mmvqmmqdmmvesimd-kernel-familie.title: MMVQ/MMQ/DMMV/ESIMD kernel families
concepts/mmvqmmqdmmvesimd-kernel-familie.description: SYCL quantized GEMM kernels dispatched by batch size and force flags; MMVQ is the production batch=1 TG kernel, coalesced DMMV a fallback/debug path.

concepts/multi-context-device-contention.title: Multi-context device contention
concepts/multi-context-device-contention.description: Winner-holds-forever graph-invocation behavior plus exactly-once DEVICE_BUSY refusal for other contexts; open question under llama.cpp-u7vj (P2), with same-device concurrent inference unsupported per contract §5.

concepts/multi-gpu-device-collapse.title: Multi-GPU device collapse
concepts/multi-gpu-device-collapse.description: On current Level Zero multi-GPU runtimes the scheduler-visible device set collapses to one device, so all contexts in a process share device 0's registry slot regardless of how many physical GPUs are installed.

concepts/multi-gpu-moe-ggmlsyclmoemultig.title: Multi-GPU MoE (GGML_SYCL_MOE_MULTI_GPU)
concepts/multi-gpu-moe-ggmlsyclmoemultig.description: Opt-in multi-device path that moves expert data between cards; host-bounces here because the cards cannot DMA to each other.

concepts/no-weight-streaming.title: No weight streaming
concepts/no-weight-streaming.description: Copying host-resident weights into device scratch per dispatch is forbidden (a PCIe copy plus scratch pressure); the answer is CPU expert dispatch overlapped via sycl::depends_on.

concepts/no-zero-copy-host-reads.title: No zero-copy host reads
concepts/no-zero-copy-host-reads.description: Feeding a host-pinned pointer to a GPU kernel is forbidden — measured slower (11.3 GB/s vs CPU AOS 18–30 GB/s) and a break of the tier abstraction.

concepts/non-owning-storage-handle-route.title: Non-owning storage-handle route
concepts/non-owning-storage-handle-route.description: Per-expert slices of the buffer's managed_handle that are owning ref-counted leases but not cache entries — published transactionally and consulted by the expert resolver before any cache key is formed.

concepts/one-layout-per-weight.title: One layout per weight
concepts/one-layout-per-weight.description: The MXFP4 MoE layout chokepoint is a single per-weight planning-time decision with no PP/decode caller identity — no duplicate layouts per weight and no dispatch-time layout shifts.

concepts/opt-out-default-on-variable-pol.title: Opt-out (default ON) variable polarity
concepts/opt-out-default-on-variable-pol.description: Performance-critical GGML_SYCL_* flags default ON and are disabled by opt-out, in contrast to experimental opt-in flags that default OFF.

concepts/opt-out-performance-defaults.title: Opt-out performance defaults
concepts/opt-out-performance-defaults.description: The fork's performance-critical SYCL features default ON and are disabled by setting their GGML_SYCL_* variable, so disabling a 'fix' is always an opt-out, not an opt-in.

concepts/oracle-fit-ratio.title: Oracle fit ratio
concepts/oracle-fit-ratio.description: Judging kernel accuracy by the ratio of fit between two oracles (dfloat vs q8_1-MMVQ) rather than by an absolute tolerance.

concepts/owner-first-allocation.title: Owner-first allocation
concepts/owner-first-allocation.description: unified_allocate_owner allocates the intrusive alloc_owner_control before the physical allocation, so an allocation can never exist without an owner.

concepts/pcipcie-topology-restriction.title: PCI/PCIe topology restriction
concepts/pcipcie-topology-restriction.description: A limitation imposed by which root ports/switches a device hangs off, independent of card identity — why the B580→B70 swap in the same slot changed nothing.

concepts/peer-to-peer-p2p-dma.title: Peer-to-peer (P2P) DMA
concepts/peer-to-peer-p2p-dma.description: Direct device-to-device memory transfer over PCIe; absent here because the two cards do not share an upstream or whitelisted host bridge.

concepts/per-allocation-hardware-caps.title: Per-allocation hardware caps
concepts/per-allocation-hardware-caps.description: Clean enforcement of per-allocation size limits by the patched runtime; reverting to stock without the old allocation check can reintroduce silent oversized-allocation hangs.

concepts/pl2-throttling.title: PL2 throttling
concepts/pl2-throttling.description: throttle/status or act_freq nonzero under tile0/gt0/freq0; alone decayed identical-binary readings 2–5× with a clean kernel log.

concepts/placement-decided-once.title: Placement decided once
concepts/placement-decided-once.description: Placement is chosen for fit and execution optimality in a single planning pass and is never re-litigated by the dispatcher at op time; symmetric failure modes (zero-copy reads, weight streaming) are structurally forbidden.

concepts/placement-decides-the-executor.title: Placement decides the executor
concepts/placement-decides-the-executor.description: The planning pass decides where data lives; inference then executes each op where its data already is — VRAM operand on that GPU, host-pinned operand on the CPU.

concepts/placement-lifetime-transient-vi.title: Placement / lifetime / transient-view triad
concepts/placement-lifetime-transient-vi.description: The core invariant: the cache owns placement, the mem_handle owns lifetime, and a raw pointer is only a transient view resolved for one immediate use and never stored.

concepts/placement-plan.title: Placement plan
concepts/placement-plan.description: The model-load-time plan (compute_placement_plan → placement_plan) that is the sole authority for where weights, MoE experts, KV layers, and scratch live, assigning each a device and VRAM zone.

concepts/pp512-tg128.title: PP512 / TG128
concepts/pp512-tg128.description: Prompt-processing (512-token) and token-generation (128-new-token) throughput metrics in tok/s.

concepts/presence-tested-env-var.title: Presence-tested env var
concepts/presence-tested-env-var.description: GGML_SYCL_UNIFIED_FORCE_LEGACY is checked via getenv != nullptr, so =0 enables the bypass and the static latches per process.

concepts/q81-activation-quantization.title: q8_1 activation quantization
concepts/q81-activation-quantization.description: MMVQ's activation format: 8 bits per 32-element block, scale amax/127, per-block sum, both stored as fp16, matching the upstream CUDA convention.

concepts/refusible-release.title: Refusible release
concepts/refusible-release.description: Dropping the last reference calls into the device's allocation_release_coordinator, which may return RETRY_SCHEDULED; the retry is queued via a retry_next_ pointer that allocates nothing, so it works under memory pressure.

concepts/routing-dependent-flag-effect.title: Routing-dependent flag effect
concepts/routing-dependent-flag-effect.description: A dispatch flag whose cost depends on the model's default routing — a no-op on GPT-OSS but ~⅔ PP loss on Mistral.

concepts/scratch-ring-admission.title: Scratch ring admission
concepts/scratch-ring-admission.description: The MoE oneDNN scratch ring is sized for all n_expert experts and admission is fail-closed (since f2bdfbffe), so plan-time sizing mistakes (e.g. stale WOQ arm choice) make admission refuse every dispatch.

concepts/session-drift.title: Session drift
concepts/session-drift.description: Within-session throughput drift (a B50 block climbed 7% across five identical runs) that makes sequential blocks inseparable from flag effects.

concepts/shmem-ceiling.title: Shmem ceiling
concepts/shmem-ceiling.description: Shmem in /proc/meminfo above 10 GB, the TTM-shmem OOM signature this repo has hit repeatedly.

concepts/sign-flip-under-blocked-design.title: Sign flip under blocked design
concepts/sign-flip-under-blocked-design.description: Same-flag measurements yielding −3.6% (sequential) vs +2.3% (interleaved), showing blocked output is not a measurement of the flag.

concepts/single-allocation-entry-point.title: Single allocation entry point
concepts/single-allocation-entry-point.description: All runtime/scratch/staging/KV/compute allocation goes through unified_allocate, which routes by alloc_intent to a tier and VRAM zone; a raw sycl::malloc may occur only inside the cache implementation.

concepts/single-allocator-invariant.title: Single-allocator invariant
concepts/single-allocator-invariant.description: All backend allocation flows through one allocator (the unified cache) and is owned by one lifetime token (mem_handle); raw allocation calls, raw pointer keying, and stored raw pointers are forbidden.

concepts/stableidentityhash.title: stable_identity_hash
concepts/stableidentityhash.description: The stable handle identity used to key pointer tables and dispatch caches, in place of a transient device pointer.

concepts/staging-scope-boundary.title: Staging scope boundary
concepts/staging-scope-boundary.description: Staging that converts the format of device-resident data (e.g., on-device MXFP4 dequant to f16 scratch) is not a placement violation — the rule governs residency, not layout conversion — but such conversion scratch belongs to planned zones.

concepts/stale-gpu-tenant.title: Stale GPU tenant
concepts/stale-gpu-tenant.description: A live llama-cli/llama-bench/llama-completion process that depresses co-taken readings and can mask a real hardware defect.

concepts/sycl-graph-replay.title: SYCL graph replay
concepts/sycl-graph-replay.description: Command-graph record/replay submission path; a replay-active graph currently never reaches a terminal state, so its invocation is held indefinitely (release_invocation no-ops), blocking other contexts with a one-shot DEVICE_BUSY.

concepts/tensor-identity-ggmlsyclcacheid.title: Tensor identity (ggml_sycl_cache_id)
concepts/tensor-identity-ggmlsyclcacheid.description: The stable identity key for WEIGHT handles, distinct from the transient pointer; a tensor that never went through a minting occasion has no owner and cannot be admitted at all.

concepts/tg-fast-path.title: TG fast-path
concepts/tg-fast-path.description: The ggml_sycl_mul_mat() shortcut for batch=1 quantized non-AoS MUL_MAT — it dispatches MMVQ and returns before any FORCE_DMMV or LAYOUT_OVERRIDE read, so MMVQ is the production TG kernel.

concepts/tg-vs-pp.title: TG vs PP
concepts/tg-vs-pp.description: Token generation (decode, batch=1) and prompt processing (batch>1) are the two workload axes the flags tune separately; many changes bank a PP win at a TG cost or vice versa (e.g. Q8_DENSE_AOS).

concepts/tiered-memory-hierarchy.title: Tiered memory hierarchy
concepts/tiered-memory-hierarchy.description: Device VRAM → pinned host → mmap hierarchy that the cache must be free to migrate allocations between at any time without dangling pointers.

concepts/typed-allocation-errors.title: Typed allocation errors
concepts/typed-allocation-errors.description: allocation_result::error distinguishes INVALID_REQUEST, CONTROL_ALLOCATION_FAILED, PHYSICAL_ALLOCATION_FAILED, METADATA_PUBLICATION_FAILED, and RELEASE_RETAINED.

concepts/usm-compression-upstream-pr-930.title: USM compression (upstream PR 930)
concepts/usm-compression-upstream-pr-930.description: Upstream USM compression fix included in the patched compute-runtime build.

concepts/usm-unified-shared-memory.title: USM (Unified Shared Memory)
concepts/usm-unified-shared-memory.description: Unified shared-memory allocation model; a direct D2D USM copy between the two cards fails in both directions despite ample free VRAM.

concepts/vram-budget.title: VRAM budget
concepts/vram-budget.description: The enforced device-memory cap min(total*pct, free_at_init) that gates allocation and eviction behavior.

concepts/vram-zone.title: VRAM zone
concepts/vram-zone.description: Budgeted fixed regions of the VRAM arena (vram_zone_id: KV, WEIGHT, ONEDNN, RUNTIME, SCRATCH) allocated via arena/zone TLSF sub-allocation.

concepts/weight-handle-leases.title: WEIGHT handle leases
concepts/weight-handle-leases.description: Weights are handed out as WEIGHT-kind handles keyed by tensor identity that hold a lease (in_use_count) on the cache entry; lazy generation-counter resolution permits transparent VRAM↔host migration, and eviction may only remove entries with in_use_count == 0.

concepts/weight-memory-layouts-soa-aos-c.title: Weight memory layouts (SOA / AOS / COALESCED / XMX_TILED)
concepts/weight-memory-layouts-soa-aos-c.description: Per-weight data layouts for quantized weights, chosen by the layout policy at planning time under the one-layout-per-weight rule; overridable per-weight via GGML_SYCL_LAYOUT_OVERRIDE.

concepts/winner-holds-forever-devicebusy.title: Winner-holds-forever DEVICE_BUSY
concepts/winner-holds-forever-devicebusy.description: Multi-context failure mode where the first context to begin a tracked graph on a device holds its invocation indefinitely and every other context's claim is refused exactly once with no path to later success; under open P2 adjudication (llama.cpp-u7vj).

concepts/woq-gemm-weight-only-quantized.title: WOQ GEMM (weight-only-quantized)
concepts/woq-gemm-weight-only-quantized.description: Batched oneDNN matmul consuming 4-bit MXFP4 weights plus e8m0 scales directly (repacked into ~4x-smaller scratch), avoiding f16 dequant; runs woq_gemm_batch_mxfp4.

concepts/xmxtiled-grouped-dpas-route.title: XMX_TILED grouped-DPAS route
concepts/xmxtiled-grouped-dpas-route.description: Intel XMX matrix-extend grouped-DPAS kernel route for MXFP4 MoE gate/up/down projections, selected by planner/admission gates at layout time; productized for PP and enabled for the down projection.

entities/0b7b49e07.title: 0b7b49e07
entities/0b7b49e07.description: The commit at which unified_allocate_owner had 48 call sites (25 in ggml-sycl.cpp, 23 across common, fattn, vram-pool, unified-cache and private fixtures).

entities/agentsmd.title: AGENTS.md
entities/agentsmd.description: Former doc that was the only documentation of GGML_SYCL_LAYOUT_OVERRIDE before the 2026-07-25 migration into this catalog.

entities/artifactsperf-recoveryc4-pp-val.title: artifacts/perf-recovery/C4-pp-validation.md
entities/artifactsperf-recoveryc4-pp-val.description: Artifact holding the full C4 PP snapshot matrix and ONEDNN_VERBOSE share analysis.

entities/artifactsperf-recoveryd3-b70-ba.title: artifacts/perf-recovery/D3-b70-baseline.md
entities/artifactsperf-recoveryd3-b70-ba.description: Artifact deriving the Track E B70 flip thresholds (pp512 ≥ 1351.5, tg128 ≥ 48.5).

entities/b50-b70.title: B50 / B70
entities/b50-b70.description: The two GPU cards discussed; their differing capabilities (tile shapes, XMX generation) make optimal weight layout a per-device answer.

entities/battlemage-g21.title: Battlemage G21
entities/battlemage-g21.description: Battlemage GPU device/die of the Arc Pro B50.

entities/battlemage-g31.title: Battlemage G31
entities/battlemage-g31.description: Battlemage GPU device/die of the Arc Pro B70.

entities/canaccesspeer.title: can_access_peer
entities/canaccesspeer.description: Device-level P2P capability query that honestly returns false for access_supported and atomics_supported in both directions.

entities/claudemd.title: CLAUDE.md
entities/claudemd.description: Project notes file holding the durable rules (what is installed, rollback, no-direct-P2P restriction); this file is the full record.

entities/codescout.title: codescout
entities/codescout.description: Tool whose embedder was secretly resident on the B50 during old default-arm baseline runs, invalidating the ~894/~1415 pp512 baselines (masking-bug class).

entities/comfyui.title: ComfyUI
entities/comfyui.description: Background workload that once held 18.3 GiB on the B70 and invalidated an entire round of measurements.

entities/computeplacementplan-placementp.title: compute_placement_plan / placement_plan
entities/computeplacementplan-placementp.description: The Planner primitive and its output: the sole authority for deciding where memory lives, run once at model load for dense weights, MoE experts, per-layer KV, and oneDNN scratch.

entities/cpuexpertpool.title: CpuExpertPool
entities/cpuexpertpool.description: CPU-side expert dispatch machinery for host-resident MoE experts, live in ggml_sycl_mul_mat_id.

entities/dmmv.title: DMMV
entities/dmmv.description: Coalesced kernel that is a fallback/debug path, not the production TG kernel for reorder-eligible types.

entities/dnnlgemmwrapper.title: DnnlGemmWrapper
entities/dnnlgemmwrapper.description: C++ oneDNN wrapper exposing woq_gemm_batch_mxfp4 and gemm_batch_strided for batched MoE matmuls (gemm.hpp).

entities/docsbackendsycl-env-varsmd.title: docs/backend/sycl-env-vars.md
entities/docsbackendsycl-env-varsmd.description: Reference documenting the SYCL environment-variable rows, including the batched-MoE-PP flag.

entities/docsbackendsycl-perf-baselinesm.title: docs/backend/sycl-perf-baselines.md
entities/docsbackendsycl-perf-baselinesm.description: Perf baselines doc whose old default-route rows are known-stale (masked by the codescout embedder) and must not be gated against.

entities/ensurecachedalloc.title: ensure_cached_alloc
entities/ensurecachedalloc.description: The single sanctioned exception that deliberately allocates outside the arena (direct sycl::malloc_device, budget-gated); zero production callers, 34 test call sites.

entities/extoneapienablepeeraccess.title: ext_oneapi_enable_peer_access()
entities/extoneapienablepeeraccess.description: oneAPI extension that wrongly returns OK on hardware with no P2P, making it an untrustworthy capability check.

entities/gallocr.title: gallocr
entities/gallocr.description: Buffer allocator that frees buffers first, forcing buffer destructors to drop tensor cache entries by stored key rather than dereferencing tensors.

entities/ggml.title: ggml
entities/ggml.description: Tensor/ML library whose SYCL backend (ggml/src/ggml-sycl) implements the unified cache and mem_handle design.

entities/ggml-sycl.title: ggml-sycl
entities/ggml-sycl.description: SYCL backend (ggml/src/ggml-sycl/ggml-sycl.cpp); ggml_sycl_mul_mat() hosts the TG fast-path, MMVQ dispatch, and both FORCE_DMMV sites.

entities/ggmlsrcggml-syclggml-syclcpp.title: ggml/src/ggml-sycl/ggml-sycl.cpp
entities/ggmlsrcggml-syclggml-syclcpp.description: SYCL backend file containing the TG fast-path, both FORCE_DMMV sites, and the force_legacy presence check.

entities/ggmlsyclbatchexperts.title: GGML_SYCL_BATCH_EXPERTS
entities/ggmlsyclbatchexperts.description: Opt-out (default ON) that disables batched expert kernel launches.

entities/ggmlsyclcacheid.title: ggml_sycl_cache_id
entities/ggmlsyclcacheid.description: The tensor-identity key (not pointer) under which WEIGHT handles and weight provenance rows are filed via ggml_sycl_owner_name_key(owner, tensor_name).

entities/ggmlsycldisablegraph.title: GGML_SYCL_DISABLE_GRAPH
entities/ggmlsycldisablegraph.description: Opt-out (default OFF) for SYCL graph replay; currently load-bearing for multi-context workloads due to the never-terminal replay invocation bug.

entities/ggmlsyclesimddequant.title: GGML_SYCL_ESIMD_DEQUANT
entities/ggmlsyclesimddequant.description: Opt-in (default OFF) retest hatch for ESIMD small-block dequant; the 1.9x-slower justification is a historical Arc B580 + oneAPI 2025.3 measurement.

entities/ggmlsyclfaonednnmaterialize.title: GGML_SYCL_FA_ONEDNN_MATERIALIZE
entities/ggmlsyclfaonednnmaterialize.description: Opt-in (default OFF since the 2026-08-10 olpg polarity ruling) for MATERIALIZE_REQUIRED on GQA/MQA flash-attention KV-stride-mismatch shapes; =1 retained as the A/B axis for the oneDNN SDPA plan.

entities/ggmlsyclforcedmmv.title: GGML_SYCL_FORCE_DMMV
entities/ggmlsyclforcedmmv.description: Forces DMMV kernels, but has no effect at batch=1 on its own because the TG fast-path returns before the flag is read; pair with GGML_SYCL_TG_FAST=0.

entities/ggmlsycllayoutoverride.title: GGML_SYCL_LAYOUT_OVERRIDE
entities/ggmlsycllayoutoverride.description: Forces a weight layout (aos/soa/coalesced/xmx_tiled) for A/B isolation; still binds on materialization at batch=1 even though MMVQ reads the buffer.

entities/ggmlsyclmoedownxmxtiled.title: GGML_SYCL_MOE_DOWN_XMX_TILED
entities/ggmlsyclmoedownxmxtiled.description: Opt-out (default ON since sk67) for the XMX_TILED grouped-DPAS route on the MoE down projection; previously a no-op flag.

entities/ggmlsyclmoepponednnf16batched.title: GGML_SYCL_MOE_PP_ONEDNN_F16_BATCHED
entities/ggmlsyclmoepponednnf16batched.description: Route policy (default ON on both cards since iikr) selecting the batched oneDNN MoE PP executor; gate/up keep XMX_TILED, down plans SOA; XMX_TILED-claimed declines throw fail-closed.

entities/ggmlsyclmoeppwoq.title: GGML_SYCL_MOE_PP_WOQ
entities/ggmlsyclmoeppwoq.description: Opt-out (default ON) for the WOQ arm of the batched PP MoE executor; read at both the dispatch executor and plan-time scratch sizing, so must be set before model load; the f16 fallback arm is SOA-only.

entities/ggmlsyclmoeppwoq3d.title: GGML_SYCL_MOE_PP_WOQ_3D
entities/ggmlsyclmoeppwoq3d.description: Opt-in (default OFF) for the known-broken 3-D scale mask in the WOQ batched GEMM; unset now means the correct 2-D loop directly; do not re-enable 3-D in production.

entities/ggmlsyclmulmatroutetrace.title: GGML_SYCL_MUL_MAT_ROUTE_TRACE
entities/ggmlsyclmulmatroutetrace.description: Route trace emitting the kernel and layout at dispatch on both routes; LIMIT defaults to 256; survives the GGML_LOG_INFO verbosity gate.

entities/ggmlsyclmxfp4groupeddpasrowlist.title: GGML_SYCL_MXFP4_GROUPED_DPAS_ROW_LIST_TILES
entities/ggmlsyclmxfp4groupeddpasrowlist.description: Caps the grouped-DPAS MXFP4 MoE row-list chunk size (caps.N*N rows per submission); default 256, raised from 16 on 2026-08-17 for +7.5% B50 / ~+30% B70 pp512.

entities/ggmlsyclonednnmul.title: GGML_SYCL_ONEDNN_MUL
entities/ggmlsyclonednnmul.description: Opt-in (default OFF) enabling oneDNN for element-wise MUL; the SYCL kernel is 2.3x faster by default.

entities/ggmlsyclonednnpp.title: GGML_SYCL_ONEDNN_PP
entities/ggmlsyclonednnpp.description: Opt-out (default ON) that disables oneDNN for prompt processing.

entities/ggmlsycloptimeoutms.title: GGML_SYCL_OP_TIMEOUT_MS
entities/ggmlsycloptimeoutms.description: Watchdog timeout variable; B70 runs require 180000 because cold prestage exceeds the 30 s default.

entities/ggmlsyclpppipeline.title: GGML_SYCL_PP_PIPELINE
entities/ggmlsyclpppipeline.description: Opt-in (default OFF) double-buffered FP16 weight dequant prefetch; improves B50 GPT-OSS PP to ~1030–1043 tok/s but chat correctness currently fails with repeated isNaN.

entities/ggmlsyclpublishbackendaosexpert.title: ggml_sycl_publish_backend_aos_expert_handles
entities/ggmlsyclpublishbackendaosexpert.description: Publishes per-expert slices of the buffer's managed_handle on tensor extra records, transactionally, at the three points where an AoS upload becomes complete.

entities/ggmlsyclq8denseaos.title: GGML_SYCL_Q8_DENSE_AOS
entities/ggmlsyclq8denseaos.description: Opt-in (default OFF) routing Q8_0 dense projections AOS so PP batches hit the oneDNN arm; +38% B70 pp512 but −34% B50 tg128, superseded for the PP win by GGML_SYCL_Q8_ONEDNN_COALESCED.

entities/ggmlsyclq8onednncoalesced.title: GGML_SYCL_Q8_ONEDNN_COALESCED
entities/ggmlsyclq8onednncoalesced.description: Opt-out (default ON) enabling the layout-neutral ONEDNN_COALESCED Q8_0 arm above batch 8, keeping TG on the coalesced kernel.

entities/ggmlsyclresolvemoeexpertroute-g.title: ggml_sycl_resolve_moe_expert_route / ggml_sycl_try_moe_storage_handle_route
entities/ggmlsyclresolvemoeexpertroute-g.description: Expert route resolution that tries the non-owning storage-handle route for each candidate layout before forming any cache key; a hit returns FOUND and the cache is never consulted.

entities/ggmlsycltgfast.title: GGML_SYCL_TG_FAST
entities/ggmlsycltgfast.description: Opt-out (default ON) that disables the batch=1 MMVQ TG fast-path; the only way to make GGML_SYCL_FORCE_DMMV or a GGML_SYCL_LAYOUT_OVERRIDE kernel choice bind at batch=1.

entities/ggmlsyclunifiedforcelegacy.title: GGML_SYCL_UNIFIED_FORCE_LEGACY
entities/ggmlsyclunifiedforcelegacy.description: Opt-in (default OFF) that forces legacy kernel dispatch, skipping the unified kernel.

entities/ggmlsyclunifiedsoa.title: GGML_SYCL_UNIFIED_SOA
entities/ggmlsyclunifiedsoa.description: Opt-out (default ON) that disables SOA memory layout, falling back to AOS and ~4x slower TG.

entities/ggmlsyclusexmxgemm.title: GGML_SYCL_USE_XMX_GEMM
entities/ggmlsyclusexmxgemm.description: Routes quantized MUL_MAT through experimental XMX GEMM kernels (measured 5–11x slower); no-op unless the build carries both GGML_SYCL_XMX_GEMM and GGML_SYCL_MMQ_XMX.

entities/ggmlsyclxmxmoesorted.title: GGML_SYCL_XMX_MOE_SORTED
entities/ggmlsyclxmxmoesorted.description: Opt-in (default OFF) diagnostic-only sorted MoE wrapper (try_xmx_sorted_moe); once pre-empted the grouped-DPAS PP route, measuring 5x slower on B70 and aborting (rc=134) on B50.

entities/ggmlsyclxmxthreshold.title: GGML_SYCL_XMX_THRESHOLD
entities/ggmlsyclxmxthreshold.description: Upper batch bound for the XMX GEMM path (batch >= 1 && batch < N); default 64, stated only in the ggml_check_sycl() settings table.

entities/ggmlsyclxmxtiledpp.title: GGML_SYCL_XMX_TILED_PP
entities/ggmlsyclxmxtiledpp.description: Opt-out (default ON) for the XMX_TILED grouped-DPAS PP route for MXFP4 gate/up; older GGML_SYCL_XMX_MOE_ALLOW_UNSAFE_PP/GGML_SYCL_XMX_MOE_PP names still honored as compatibility opt-outs.

entities/gpt-oss.title: GPT-OSS
entities/gpt-oss.description: Model used in a full bench run through llama.cpp's isolated/host-bounce path on the historical B580↔B50 pair.

entities/gpt-oss-20b-mxfp4.title: GPT-OSS 20B (MXFP4)
entities/gpt-oss-20b-mxfp4.description: Benchmark model (gpt-oss-20b-mxfp4.gguf) for FA-on baselines and the count correctness gate.

entities/igc.title: IGC
entities/igc.description: Intel GPU Compiler whose installed version does not recognize 26.22's future Xe3p/NVLP built-ins, motivating the BMG-only build config.

entities/intel-arc-a580.title: Intel Arc A580
entities/intel-arc-a580.description: Discrete card removed from this machine on 2026-07-24; its P2P test results are historical and superseded by the B70.

entities/intel-arc-b580.title: Intel Arc B580
entities/intel-arc-b580.description: Older Battlemage card removed from this machine on 2026-07-24 (replaced by the Arc Pro B70); its baselines are SUPERSEDED and gate nothing.

entities/intel-arc-pro-b50.title: Intel Arc Pro B50
entities/intel-arc-pro-b50.description: Secondary benchmark card in this machine (Battlemage G21, PCI 0000:07:00.0, level_zero:1, ~16.2 GB VRAM); unchanged through the B580→B70 swap.

entities/intel-arc-pro-b70.title: Intel Arc Pro B70
entities/intel-arc-pro-b70.description: Primary benchmark card in this machine (Battlemage G31, 256 CU, PCI 0000:03:00.0, level_zero:0, ~32.6 GB VRAM); replaced the B580 on 2026-07-24.

entities/intel-compute-runtime.title: Intel compute-runtime
entities/intel-compute-runtime.description: Patched 26.22 Battlemage/BMG-only build installed as the system-default Level Zero driver from branch llama/26.22-cross-device.

entities/level-zero.title: Level Zero
entities/level-zero.description: Khronos low-level GPU API whose loader, tracing, and validation libraries this machine's processes must resolve from the packaged path.

entities/libzeintelgpuso.title: libze_intel_gpu.so
entities/libzeintelgpuso.description: Intel's Level Zero runtime library; patched 1.15.38646 is the diverted system default, with stock 1.14.37020 and prior 26.09 builds preserved.

entities/libzeloaderso.title: libze_loader.so
entities/libzeloaderso.description: Level Zero loader whose stale copy in /usr/local/lib was quarantined so new processes resolve the packaged /usr/lib loader.

entities/llama-bench.title: llama-bench
entities/llama-bench.description: Benchmark binary used for all throughput measurements; -v prints the free-VRAM line.

entities/llama-cli.title: llama-cli
entities/llama-cli.description: Inference binary counted as a stale GPU tenant by the bench guard; does not print the free-VRAM line.

entities/llama-completion.title: llama-completion
entities/llama-completion.description: Inference binary counted as a stale GPU tenant by the bench guard.

entities/llamacpp.title: llama.cpp
entities/llamacpp.description: Inference framework whose isolated/host-bounce multi-device path (GGML_SYCL_MOE_MULTI_GPU) is constrained by the P2P restriction.

entities/llamacpp-sycl-fork.title: llama.cpp (SYCL fork)
entities/llamacpp-sycl-fork.description: The repo this baseline document belongs to, with an actively developed SYCL backend.

entities/mem-handle.title: mem_handle
entities/mem-handle.description: ggml_sycl::mem_handle - the backend's ownership/lifetime token: lightweight, copyable, ref-counted; resolves to the current pointer on dereference.

entities/mistral.title: Mistral
entities/mistral.description: Model used for the end-to-end 'digit gate' verification of the DIRECT flash-attention plan.

entities/mistral-7b-q40.title: Mistral 7B Q4_0
entities/mistral-7b-q40.description: Benchmark model, steadier on the B70 than GPT-OSS; used for the deterministic completion gate.

entities/mmvq.title: MMVQ
entities/mmvq.description: Production batch=1 quantized MUL_MAT kernel using q8_1 activations for reorder-eligible types.

entities/mxfp4.title: MXFP4
entities/mxfp4.description: 4-bit quantized format with layout-aware _id launchers and an on-device dequant path into f16 scratch for oneDNN.

entities/ocloc.title: ocloc
entities/ocloc.description: OpenCL-to-ISA compiler tool, referenced alongside IGC for the 26.22 built-in compatibility limitation.

entities/oneapi.title: oneAPI
entities/oneapi.description: Intel AI development toolchain; version 2025.3 was used in the historical ESIMD dequant measurement.

entities/oneapi-20253.title: oneAPI 2025.3
entities/oneapi-20253.description: Toolchain version paired with the B580 in the historical ESIMD small-block dequant measurement.

entities/oneapideviceselector.title: ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR
entities/oneapideviceselector.description: Environment variable keying device identity (level_zero:0 = B70, level_zero:1 = B50); the logged device=N is assigned after selector filtering.

entities/onednn.title: oneDNN
entities/onednn.description: DNN library whose scratch allocations and calls flow through the unified cache; its on-device dequant (e.g. MXFP4 → f16) is a permitted format-conversion staging.

entities/openvino.title: OpenVINO
entities/openvino.description: Runtime of the embedder tenant (semantic.openvino_device=GPU.2) that confounded the A–D rows.

entities/q81.title: Q8_1
entities/q81.description: Quantization type whose scratch demand (unified_cache_reserve_moe_q8_1_scratch) sizes the scratch pool as one epoch's full capacity.

entities/scriptsbench-guardsh.title: scripts/bench-guard.sh
entities/scriptsbench-guardsh.description: Mandatory preflight guard that refuses corrupted hosts (exit 3) and stamps VALID/SUSPECT as the first line of archived benchmark logs.

entities/sycl.title: SYCL
entities/sycl.description: C++ GPU programming model used by the backend (sycl::queue, sycl::malloc_device, sycl::depends_on, sycl::free).

entities/sycl-canonical-memory-architect.title: SYCL canonical memory architecture (design doc)
entities/sycl-canonical-memory-architect.description: docs/design/sycl-canonical-memory-architecture.md — the authoritative, enforceable version of the unified-cache + mem_handle design.

entities/sycl-ls.title: sycl-ls
entities/sycl-ls.description: SYCL device enumeration tool historically used to list B580/B50 devices; flagged as not to be used for checking the B50 now.

entities/test-thread-safety.title: test-thread-safety
entities/test-thread-safety.description: ctest (3 models × 4 contexts, decodes serialized per device) whose registration sets GGML_SYCL_DISABLE_GRAPH=1; fails at 3.4s with replay on, passes at 6.95s with replay off.

entities/teststest-bench-guardsh.title: tests/test-bench-guard.sh
entities/teststest-bench-guardsh.description: Test covering the bench guard; also runnable via ctest -R '^test-bench-guard$'.

entities/teststest-dmmv-q4-0-coalescedcp.title: tests/test-dmmv-q4-0-coalesced.cpp
entities/teststest-dmmv-q4-0-coalescedcp.description: Test gating on the dfloat-vs-q8_1-MMVQ oracle fit ratio (≥100×), cleared by 4239–8150× when DMMV runs.

entities/ttm-shmem.title: TTM-shmem
entities/ttm-shmem.description: Kernel shmem allocator whose >10 GB usage in /proc/meminfo is a bench-guard preflight refusal.

entities/unified-cache.title: unified_cache
entities/unified-cache.description: ggml_sycl::unified_cache — the sole allocator and owner of SYCL backend memory (tiered weight cache, VRAM arena and zones, host pinned pool).

entities/unifiedallocate.title: unified_allocate
entities/unifiedallocate.description: The single allocation entry point: routes an alloc_request by intent to a tier and VRAM zone and returns a mem_handle; the older unified_alloc/unified_free pair still backs the same machinery.

entities/unifiedallocateowner.title: unified_allocate_owner
entities/unifiedallocateowner.description: Owner-first allocation front door that allocates the intrusive alloc_owner_control before the physical allocation, so an allocation can never exist without an owner (48 call sites at 0b7b49e07).
